questions.content:
(1) 画出等效电路图如下

判断思路:①直流不短路，说明电感没有单独位于一个支路上；②高频区域阻抗趋于零，说明电容位于单独支路上；③阻抗存在极大值，属并联谐振现象

(2) 单位长度上分布电容等价于一个内外半径为 $R_{1}, R_{2}$ 的柱形电容器:

(3)（3.1）由题意，载流子为电子，受到电场力 $-eEe^{i\omega t}$ 及等效阻尼力 $-\frac{m\vec{v}}{\tau}$

$$m\frac{d\vec{v}}{dt} = -eEe^{i\omega t}-\frac{m\vec{v}}{\tau}.\tag{9}$$

代入试探解 $v = Ae^{i\omega t}$

$$\left(im\omega+\frac{m}{\tau}\right)Ae^{i\omega t} = -eEe^{i\omega t}\tag{10}$$

解得

$$v = \frac{-eEe^{i\omega t}}{im\omega+\frac{m}{\tau}}\tag{11}$$

电流密度为

$$j = -nev = \frac{ne^{2}Ee^{i\omega t}}{im\omega+\frac{m}{\tau}}\tag{12}$$

微观欧姆定律

$$j = \sigma Ee^{i\omega t}\tag{13}$$

从而体系电导率为

$$\sigma = \frac{ne^{2}}{im\omega+\frac{m}{\tau}} = \frac{ne^{2}}{\sqrt{m^{2}\omega^{2}+\frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}e^{i\omega}\tag{14}$$

取模长

$$|\sigma| = \frac{ne^{2}}{\sqrt{m^{2}\omega^{2}+\frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}\tag{15}$$

(3.2) 令 $\kappa(x) = \frac{\pi^{2}k}{3\epsilon^{2}}|\sigma|T(x) = aT(x)$，分析平衡时微元 $x \sim x+dx$ 的传热。
questions.analysis:
$$C = \frac{2\pi\epsilon_{0}}{\ln\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}}\tag{1}$$

求解分布电感时，由于中空圆柱体的内外表面均存在趋肤效应，且根据题设电流密度处处相同，则电流在内柱面和外柱面上按半径分配。显然，单位长度上内禀磁通仅由内柱面上电流提供。

$$\phi = \int_{R_{1}}^{R_{2}} \frac{\mu_{0} i}{2\pi r} \frac{R_{1}}{R_{1}+R_{2}} dr = \frac{\mu_{0} i}{2\pi} \frac{R_{1}}{R_{1}+R_{2}} \ln\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}\tag{2}$$

从而单位长度上分布电感

$$L = \frac{\phi}{i} = \frac{\mu_{0}}{2\pi} \frac{R_{1}}{R_{1}+R_{2}} \ln\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}\tag{3}$$

单位长度上电阻 $\lambda = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\sigma\omega\mu}}$

$$R = \frac{1}{\sigma} \frac{1}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda}\tag{4}$$

从而体系复阻抗

$$Z = \frac{\frac{1}{j\omega C}(R+j\omega L)}{\frac{1}{j\omega C}+R+j\omega L} = \frac{R-j\omega C\left[R^{2}+\omega L\left(\omega L-\frac{1}{\omega C}\right)\right]}{\omega^{2}C^{2}\left[R^{2}+\left(\omega L-\frac{1}{\omega C}\right)^{2}\right]}\tag{5}$$

取模长

$$\left|Z\right| = \frac{\sqrt{R^{2}+\omega^{2}C^{2}\left[R^{2}+\omega L\left(\omega L-\frac{1}{\omega C}\right)\right]^{2}}}{\omega^{2}C^{2}\left[R^{2}+\left(\omega L-\frac{1}{\omega C}\right)^{2}\right]}\tag{6}$$

在 $R << \omega L, \frac{1}{\omega C}$ 的情况下，略去 $R^{2}$ 之后轻易可以发现

$$f_{c} = \frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}} = \frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{\mu_{0}\epsilon_{0}\frac{R_{1}}{R_{1}+R_{2}}}}\tag{7}$$

代入可得

$$Z_{c} = \frac{\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}C^{2}R^{2}}}{\omega^{2}C^{2}R},\tag{8}$$

$$-\kappa_{\varepsilon}\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})\frac{dT}{dx}\Big|_{x}+dP = -\kappa_{\varepsilon}\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})\frac{dT}{dx}\Big|_{x+dx}+2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})dxA(T-T_{0})\tag{16}$$

整理得到

$$\pi\left(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2}\right)\frac{d}{dx}\left(aT\frac{dT}{dx}\right) = 2\pi\left(R_{1}+R_{2}\right)A\left(T-T_{0}\right)-\frac{dP}{dx}\tag{17}$$

为了求解电功率 $dP/dx$，首先写出电流

$$j = \frac{\sqrt{2}i}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda}e^{i\omega t}\tag{19}$$

对应电场

$$E = \frac{j}{\sigma} = \frac{\sqrt{2}i\sqrt{m^{2}\omega^{2}+\frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda ne^{2}}e^{i(\omega t-\phi)}\tag{20}$$

从而热功率为

$$\frac{dP}{dx} = \frac{\vec{j}\cdot\vec{E}}{\left|\vec{j}\right|\cdot\frac{1}{\vec{E}}\cdot\frac{1}{dx}} = \frac{i^{2}\sqrt{m^{2}\omega^{2}+\frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda ne^{2}}\cos\phi = i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{1}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda}\cos(\arctan(\omega\tau))\tag{21}$$

整理得

$$\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})a\left(\left(\frac{dT}{dx}\right)^{2}+T\frac{d^{2}T}{dx^{2}}\right) = 2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})A(T-T_{0})-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{1}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\tag{22}$$

注意到 $\frac{d^{2}T}{dx^{2}} = \frac{1}{2}\frac{dT'^{2}}{dT}$，上式可化为

$$\frac{dT'^{2}}{dT}+\frac{2}{T}T'^{2} = \frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})aT}\left[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})A(T-T_{0})-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{1}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\right]\tag{23}$$

为标准的一阶线性微分方程，其通解

$$\begin{aligned}T'^{2} = & e^{-\int\frac{2}{T}dT}\Big(\int\frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})aT}\big[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})A(T-T_{0}) \\ & -i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{1}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\big]e^{\int\frac{2}{T}dT}dT+C\Big)\end{aligned}\tag{24}$$

完成积分，并利用边界条件 $T'\big|_{x=0} = 0$（$x=0$ 处无热通量）定解

$$\begin{aligned}T'^{2} = \frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})} & aT^{2}\Big[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})A\left(\frac{1}{3}(T^{3}-T_{1}^{3})-\frac{1}{2}T_{0}(T^{2}-T_{1}^{2})\right) \\ & -i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T^{2}-T_{1}^{2}}{4\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\Big]\end{aligned}\tag{25}$$

分离变量

$$dx = \frac{dT}{\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})aT^{2}}\left[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})A\left(\frac{1}{3}(T^{3}-T_{1}^{3})-\frac{1}{2}T_{0}(T^{2}-T_{1}^{2})\right)-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T^{2}-T_{1}^{2}}{4\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\right]}}\tag{26}$$

假设 $T-T_{1} << T_{1}$，以后将看到其自洽性，则

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}(T^{3}-T_{1}^{3}) &= \frac{1}{3}(T-T_{1})(T^{2}+TT_{1}+T_{1}^{2}) \approx T_{1}^{2}(T-T_{1}) \\ \frac{1}{2}T_{0}(T^{2}-T_{1}^{2}) &= \frac{1}{2}T_{0}(T+T_{1})(T-T_{1}) \approx T_{0}T_{1}(T-T_{1}) \\ dx &= \frac{TdT}{\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})a}\left[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})AT_{1}(T_{1}-T_{0})-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T_{1}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\right]}\sqrt{T-T_{1}}}\end{aligned}\tag{27}$$

完成积分

$$x = \frac{\frac{2}{3}(T-T_{1})^{\frac{3}{2}}+2T_{1}\sqrt{T-T_{1}}}{\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})a}\left[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})AT_{1}(T_{1}-T_{0})-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T_{1}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\right]}}\tag{28}$$

注意到 $T-T_{1} << T_{1}$，括号内第二项远大于第一项，最低阶近似下可以略去第一项。反解得到

$$T(x) = T_{1}+\frac{x^{2}}{2\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})aT_{1}^{2}}\left[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})AT_{1}(T_{1}-T_{0})-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T_{1}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\right]\tag{29}$$

上式即确定温度分布 $T(x)$，其中 $a = \frac{\pi^{2}k}{3\epsilon^{2}}|\sigma|$。不难发现，$T-T_{1} << T_{1}$ 自洽。

$$\pi\left(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2}\right)\frac{d}{dx}\left(aT\frac{dT}{dx}\right) = 2\pi\left(R_{1}+R_{2}\right)A\left(T-T_{0}\right)-\frac{dP}{dx}\tag{17}$$

$$j = \frac{\sqrt{2}i}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda}e^{i\omega t}\tag{19}$$

从而热功率为

$$\frac{dP}{dx} = \frac{\vec{j}\cdot\vec{E}}{\left|\vec{j}\right|\cdot\frac{1}{\vec{E}}\cdot\frac{1}{dx}} = \frac{i^{2}\sqrt{m^{2}\omega^{2}+\frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda ne^{2}}\cos\phi = i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{1}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda}\cos(\arctan(\omega\tau))\tag{21}$$

$$x = \frac{\frac{2}{3}(T-T_{1})^{\frac{3}{2}}+2T_{1}\sqrt{T-T_{1}}}{\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})a}\left[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})AT_{1}(T_{1}-T_{0})-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T_{1}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\right]}}\tag{28}$$

注意到 $T-T_{1} << T_{1}$，括号内第二项远大于第一项，最低阶近似下可以略去第一项。反解得到

$$T(x) = T_{1}+\frac{x^{2}}{2\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})aT_{1}^{2}}\left[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})AT_{1}(T_{1}-T_{0})-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T_{1}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\right]\tag{29}$$

questions.answer:
(1) 等效电路为电感与电容并联的谐振电路；

(2) 分布电容 $C = \frac{2\pi\epsilon_{0}}{\ln\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}}$，分布电感 $L = \frac{\mu_{0}}{2\pi}\frac{R_{1}}{R_{1}+R_{2}}\ln\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}$，谐振频率 $f_{c} = \frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}$；

(3) 电导率 $|\sigma| = \frac{ne^{2}}{\sqrt{m^{2}\omega^{2}+\frac{1}{\tau^{2}}}}$，温度分布 $T(x) = T_{1}+\frac{x^{2}}{2\pi(R_{2}^{2}-R_{1}^{2})aT_{1}^{2}}\left[2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})AT_{1}(T_{1}-T_{0})-i^{2}\frac{1}{|\sigma|}\frac{T_{1}}{2\pi(R_{1}+R_{2})\lambda\sqrt{1+\omega^{2}\tau^{2}}}\right]$。

score.note: 关键在识别康托尔地毯的自相似结构并建立迭代递推关系，属非常规建模；推导涉及复振幅叠加与级数求和，计算量大且易错。

questions.content:
(1)

(1.1) 矩孔衍射，从次波源相干叠加的观点写出菲涅尔衍射积分式，忽略倾斜因子。注意运算式不要落下 $\frac { - i } { \lambda }$ 因子，记得 $\frac { 1 } { r } \to \frac { 1 } { f }$ 变换。

$$u ( P ) = - \frac { i } { \lambda } \int _ { - \frac { a } { 2 } } ^ { \frac { a } { 2 } } \int _ { - \frac { a } { 2 } } ^ { \frac { a } { 2 } } u _ { 0 } \frac { e ^ { i k \cdot r } } { f } d x d y ,$$
questions.analysis:
$$U_{0}=\frac{-ia^{2}u_{0}}{\lambda f}\frac{\sin\alpha_{0}}{\alpha_{0}}\frac{\sin\beta_{0}}{\beta_{0}}\tag{1}$$

$$I = \frac{a^{4}u_{0}^{2}}{\lambda^{2}f^{2}}(\frac{\sin\alpha_{0}}{\alpha_{0}})^{2}(\frac{\sin\beta_{0}}{\beta_{0}})^{2}\tag{2}$$

其中 $\alpha_{0}=\frac{\pi a \sin \theta_{1}}{\lambda}, \beta_{0}=\frac{\pi a \sin \theta_{2}}{\lambda}$

(1.2) 衍射孔位移相当于附加相位差。在复振幅表述下相当于乘了一个复的相位因子。

$$e ^ { i \delta } = e ^ { i k ( a \sin \theta _ { 1 } + a \sin \theta _ { 2 } ) }\tag{3}$$

(2)

(2.1) 我们将八个小孔分别编号为1~8，写出他们的复振幅分别如下

$$u_{i}=c_{i}\frac{\sin\alpha_{1}}{\alpha_{1}}\frac{\sin\beta_{1}}{\beta_{1}}\tag{4}$$
